Out of the state’s 57 MPs — 39 in the Lok Sabha and 18 in the Rajya Sabha — only around 20 attended. MPs from the Congress, Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi, Communist Party of India, Communist Party of India, (Marxist), Indian Union Muslim League and Marumalarchi Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam participated, while the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam, All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam, Pattali Makkal Katchi, Desiya Murpokku Dravida Kazhagam and Makkal Needhi Maiam stayed away. Congress MP R Sudha was also absent due to party work in Karnataka.
